title: Hunts FH-016S: Player claim action, list/map and hints

source.ref: Split from FH-016 (2026-11-10): the read-only player page shipped; claiming and the map need the claim action and a map view.

detail: Add the claim action on the player page (server action through applyClaim and hunt_claim_apply, gated by the claims switch), the list/map view of visited stops and the hint reveal. Done when: a player completes a Trail end to end from the page, a second device shows the same revision, and a hidden clue never reaches the page source. Requires: FH-016, FH-020. Owner role: Web.
